text: The consumer reads `field.default` in two places, so it needs updating too. I’ll make `load_default` and `dump_default` the canonical attributes and keep `missing` and `default` as deprecated aliases. `Constant` will continue returning its constant value regardless of the supplied defaults.

arguments.command:
python - <<'PY'
p='host/src/marshmallow/fields.py'
s=open(p).read().replace(':param default: If set,', ':param dump_default: If set,').replace(':param missing: Default deserialization', ':param load_default: Default deserialization').replace('If ``missing=None``', 'If ``load_default=None``')
s=s.replace('    :param metadata: Extra information to be stored as field metadata.','    :param metadata: Extra information to be stored as field metadata.\n    :param missing: Deprecated alias for ``load_default``.\n    :param default: Deprecated alias for ``dump_default``.')
s=s.replace('    # Some fields, such as Method', '    # Some fields, such as Method',1)
s=s.replace('        default: typing.Any = missing_,\n        missing: typing.Any = missing_,','        load_default: typing.Any = missing_,\n        dump_default: typing.Any = missing_,',1)
s=s.replace('        metadata: typing.Optional[typing.Mapping[str, typing.Any]] = None,\n        **additional_metadata','        metadata: typing.Optional[typing.Mapping[str, typing.Any]] = None,\n        missing: typing.Any = missing_,\n        default: typing.Any = missing_,\n        **additional_metadata',1)
s=s.replace('        self.default = default','''        if default is not missing_:
            warnings.warn(
                "The 'default' argument to fields is deprecated. "
                "Use 'dump_default' instead.",
                RemovedInMarshmallow4Warning,
                stacklevel=2,
            )
            if dump_default is missing_:
                dump_default = default
        if missing is not missing_:
            warnings.warn(
                "The 'missing' argument to fields is deprecated. "
                "Use 'load_default' instead.",
                RemovedInMarshmallow4Warning,
                stacklevel=2,
            )
            if load_default is missing_:
                load_default = missing
        self.dump_default = dump_default
        self.load_default = load_default''',1)
s=s.replace('# If allow_none is None and missing is None','# If allow_none is None and load_default is None').replace('self.allow_none = missing is None if allow_none is None else allow_none','self.allow_none = load_default is None if allow_none is None else allow_none')
s=s.replace('        if required is True and missing is not missing_:\n            raise ValueError("\'missing\' must not be set for required fields.")','''        if required is True and load_default is not missing_:
            parameter = "missing" if missing is not missing_ else "load_default"
            raise ValueError("'{0}' must not be set for required fields.".format(parameter))''')
s=s.replace('        self.missing = missing\n','')
s=s.replace('<fields.{ClassName}(default={self.default!r}, ', '<fields.{ClassName}(dump_default={self.dump_default!r}, ').replace('"missing={self.missing}, allow_none={self.allow_none}, "','"load_default={self.load_default}, allow_none={self.allow_none}, "')
s=s.replace('default = self.default','default = self.dump_default').replace('_miss = self.missing','_miss = self.load_default')
s=s.replace('    @property\n    def context(self):','''    @property
    def default(self):
        """Deprecated alias for :attr:`dump_default`."""
        warnings.warn(
            "The 'default' attribute of fields is deprecated. Use 'dump_default' instead.",
            RemovedInMarshmallow4Warning,
            stacklevel=2,
        )
        return self.dump_default

    @default.setter
    def default(self, value):
        warnings.warn(
            "The 'default' attribute of fields is deprecated. Use 'dump_default' instead.",
            RemovedInMarshmallow4Warning,
            stacklevel=2,
        )
        self.dump_default = value

    @property
    def missing(self):
        """Deprecated alias for :attr:`load_default`."""
        warnings.warn(
            "The 'missing' attribute of fields is deprecated. Use 'load_default' instead.",
            RemovedInMarshmallow4Warning,
            stacklevel=2,
        )
        return self.load_default

    @missing.setter
    def missing(self, value):
        warnings.warn(
            "The 'missing' attribute of fields is deprecated. Use 'load_default' instead.",
            RemovedInMarshmallow4Warning,
            stacklevel=2,
        )
        self.load_default = value

    @property
    def context(self):''',1)
s=s.replace('        default: typing.Any = missing_,\n        only:', '        dump_default: typing.Any = missing_,\n        only:',1).replace('super().__init__(default=default, **kwargs)','super().__init__(dump_default=dump_default, **kwargs)',1)
s=s.replace('        self.missing = constant\n        self.default = constant','        self.load_default = constant\n        self.dump_default = constant')
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='consumer/marshmallow_jsonschema/base.py'
s=open(p).read().replace('field.default','field.dump_default')
open(p,'w').write(s)
